parameters.name: ImageURL
parameters.description:
The URL of the image. We recommend that you use an OSS link in the Shanghai region. For local files or OSS links in other regions, see [File URL processing](~~155645~~).
Image format requirements:

- Image format: JPG, JPEG, or PNG.
- Image size: No more than 6 MB.
- Image resolution: At least 128 × 128 pixels and at most 5000 × 5000 pixels. The longest side must not exceed 5000 pixels.
- Image content: Must contain at least 1 face and no more than 3 faces. Each face must be larger than 64 × 64 pixels.
- The URL cannot contain Chinese characters.
> Image content: If the image resolution exceeds the maximum limit, resize the image first. For more information, see [Image resizing](~~44688~~).

parameters.name: SlimDegree
parameters.description: The standard intensity. Valid values: \[0, 2.0]. Default value: 1.0. A larger value produces a more noticeable face slimming effect.
